issue.title: Move Launch Control into the SASE Admin Center
issue.description: Launch configuration becomes a polished, lazy Config sub-tab in the SASE Admin Center, and every Launch Control entry point—including the `,m` leader key—opens Config directly on Launch without losing current editing, override, navigation, refresh, or responsiveness guarantees.

issue.title: Extract reusable Launch content and lifecycle contracts
issue.description: launch_pane: separate Launch Control content, state, and lifecycle behavior from its standalone modal host without changing the production route.

issue.title: Integrate and route the guarded Config Launch sub-tab
issue.description: launch_integration: add the lazy Launch child behind a temporary beta flag and route every Launch Control opener through the Admin Center Config host.

issue.title: Polish, verify, and make Config Launch unconditional
issue.description: launch_cutover: finish responsive visual and interaction coverage, remove the standalone production route and temporary flag, and verify the combined epic.
